timing.note: AOUT follows a moisture change at once; the real RC detector settles in ~0.5 s after power-up and after a change.

analog.note: Linear from ~2.9 V (0 %, air) to ~1.25 V (100 %, water) of the regulated 3.3 V, 10 kΩ output resistance. Real probes are not linear, differ by ±10 % between units, and depend on soil type, salt and temperature; dry soil reads 2.2–2.6 V, wet soil 1.4–1.8 V.

power.note: Constant 5 mA load; works from 3.3 to 5.5 V; below ~3.0 V AOUT is 0.

emulates: Dry and wet voltage typical of the v1.2 board on 3.3 V and 5 V
Moisture set by prop, set_sensor_value or a scenario
doesNotEmulate: Soil type, salinity and temperature effects
Boards with a missing regulator or an NE555 that needs 5 V (common defects)
Water reaching the electronics above the line
testOnRealDevice: Read the probe in dry air and in a glass of water and use those two numbers as 0 % and 100 %
Do not push the probe past the white line; seal the board edge
Power it only while reading (a GPIO-switched supply) for battery projects
